title: Cache expiry after a DNS cutover
method: Synthetic positive-cache example. Remaining lifetime equals 300 seconds minus the answer age. It excludes serve-stale policies, application caching and negative answers; it is not a universal cutover duration.
alt: Cache expiry after a DNS cutover. Client 1: 260 seconds; Client 2: 120 seconds; Client 3: 10 seconds. Illustrative values.
